item.title: Iran’s Navy: Tanker catches fire after hitting sea mine east of Strait of Hormuz

item.title: Spokesperson urges international bodies to pursue Iran’s rights over wartime aggression
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian government spokesperson, Fatemeh Mohajerani, has called on international organizations to take an active role in securing the rights of Iranians, saying attacks on the country during two wars imposed by the US and the Israeli regime amounted to acts of terrorism rather than conventional military operations.

item.title: Iran rebuilds 1,288 schools damaged in recent aggression: Education minister
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran has rebuilt 1,288 schools damaged in recent attacks and returned them to service with the help of charitable donors, Education Minister Alireza Kazemi says, warning that the educational losses caused by school closures cannot be measured or compensated.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz will stay closed until US accepts its terms: Iran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Armed Forces have control over the Strait of Hormuz, which will remain closed until the United States accepts Tehran’s conditions, Army spokesperson Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia has said.
